test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only two people sit between D and G. Only four people sit between G and A. B sits fourth to the right of A. G is sitting immediately between B and F. F is sitting fifth to the right of C. Who is sitting at the third position from the left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) B sits fourth to the right of A.

2) Only four people sit between G and A.

3) G is sitting immediately between B and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/659a126b26655ddf386a0c400f2fbbbdcaeed405dbebe4676be965de2fff3c3d.png] 

4) Only two people sit between D and G.

5) F is sitting fifth to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba0d7e92d87f30a6fa7c8380d78242c8801c76bde18674a3d88b2fb31f619439.png] 

Here, D is sitting at the third position from the left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
